Definition: of uncertain derivation; Corinthus, a city of Greece:--Corinth.
BiblicalUsage: Corinth is a city of Greece, the church Paul wrote to twice. Acts 18:1 says Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth, 1 Corinthians 1:2 addresses the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, and 2 Corinthians 1:1 writes again to the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints in all Achaia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Corinth is the church of second chances: a city of sinners sanctified in Christ Jesus, written to twice because once was not enough.
